description: The lab's Hamilton STARlet as it really is, for Precheck and anything downstream (stage 5, AHC). Deck configs name this file in their `instrument` field. Every fact names its source: the instrument's own firmware (starlet_F553_configuration.json, read with reads only by AHC's star_readonly_probe.py) or VENUS: its deck template (config/ML_Starlet.tpl, the deck's fixed parts), the layout of what is on the deck now (ahc_deck.lay) and the commands VENUS sends. pipeline/instrument.py checks these facts against those files when it loads, so a stale value fails at once. When the instrument or its deck changes, replace the source file and update the fact here.

channels.note: Each channel reports about 18 mm wide, but the channels take a plate column at 9 mm (AHC, first runs on this instrument, 2026-11-11).

eject.source: VENUS initializes this STARlet's CO-RE 96 head over its slide waste with C0EI xs00420 xd1 yh1203 (core96slidewaste_0001 at x -42, y 120.3 in the deck template ML_Starlet.tpl) and lowers it to 229.0 mm (AHC 0.9.0, devices/hamilton/starlet.py). PyLabRobot 0.2.2 picks the same x and y but lowers to 216.4 mm; PyLabRobot 1.0's default (-46.5, 178.8) lowered the head onto the edge of the waste box.

tip_waste.note: Firmware tip_waste_x_position; the deck template's waste2 is at the same x. Whether a waste bag is fitted is checked on the deck checklist, not here.

deck_template.note: VENUS's template for this STARlet's deck: the parts that never move (waste block, tip waste, teaching needles, 96 head slide waste). The head96 eject and tip waste facts are checked against it.

deck_layout.note: What is physically on the deck. Export a new .lay from VENUS and replace this file whenever the deck changes.
